scenarios.reasoning: The agent demonstrated competent use of binlog analysis tools and produced a well-formatted summary, but critically misidentified the root cause. It incorrectly stated that LrgWindowsAppManifest was built as part of the solution when the rubric indicates it was not. This fundamental error cascaded into missing the key insight about why the output file was missing (project not in solution → wrong config → wrong output path). While the project listing and error identification were reasonable, the core analytical conclusion was wrong.
scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path
